question.text: $x \mathrm{mg}$ of pure HCl was used to make an aqueous solution. 25.0 mL of $0.1 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{Ba}(\mathrm{OH})_{2}$ solution is used when the HCl solution was titrated against it. The numerical value of $x$ is $\_\_\_\_$ $\times 10^{-1}$. (Nearest integer) Given : Molar mass of HCl and $\mathrm{Ba}(\mathrm{OH})_{2}$ are 36.5 and $171.0 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$ respectively.
